method.cohort: 100 generated profiles x30 repetitions x7 paired conditions. Seed resamples profiles as well as stochastic decisions; not independent human participants.
method.fractions: Exact pooled numerators/denominators. Summary and paired comparisons instead use mean per-trajectory metrics; do not substitute these denominators.
method.arrivals: Distinct profile/repetition pairs actually reaching each level; later levels are selected survivors, not a complete-cohort difficulty trial.
method.commonFirstAttempts: First attempt among matched profile/repetition pairs reaching the level in both conditions; common-arrival selection and different prior paths remain.
method.stops: Daily utility and availability formulas are assumptions. Administrative daily caps and horizon censoring are not spontaneous player dropout. Boundary audit: some horizon-censored attempts already have zero budget and pieces remaining. Original outcome labels are preserved; exhaustionSensitivityIncludingZeroBudgetAtHorizon separately includes those known-zero-budget rows.
method.limitedPerception: Bounded fallible mental rule model; no hidden solution supplied to search. Control still has explicit native U1 coach, earned Focus and dead-end warning.
method.oracleBoundary: No new omniscient player cohort executed. Native certified solutions may serve explicitly activated GUIDE/TRAIL/PULSE/FLOW/resonance and existing native help; automated exits and cue exposures retained separately.
method.catalog: Read frozen RelayLayouts data and ElementalShell121 assignment; authored structural scores are not calibrated human difficulty. Native visual previews/key inspection are excluded by runner.
method.quantiles: Nearest sorted index round((n-1)*q), Python ties-to-even.
method.limits: No rendered UI, sprite identification, emotion, human comprehension, enjoyment, retention or clinical/IQ calibration measured.

transferWithoutCues.design: Only final learned rule states transplanted; reset fatigue/frustration/memory, equal180 coins; all coach, dead-end, Focus, companion and causal cues disabled. Different campaign exposure is retained, so this is training-regime transfer, not a pure cue-learning causal effect.
